title: CHAOS Identity Contract V1
description: A zero-parameter statement that must hold for every observation. If it fails, either a term is mis-recorded or a flow is missing. It never contains estimated coefficients.

kind.description: stock_balance = conservation over a closed period; single_occurrence = at most one completion per intent; independent_measurement = same quantity recorded twice; definitional_ratio = algebraic relation between derived series; transfer_edge = two records of the same movement must agree in quantity and time (the break exists only between two ledgers, never inside one)

recorded_by.description: the independent process that writes this term; two terms written by the same process cannot form a testable identity

derived.description: true if the term is computed from another term; a derived term can never validate the identity

equation.description: human-readable zero-parameter equation, e.g. opening + arrivals - dispensed - expired = closing

description.description: what independent act closes the identity; empty closure means the identity cannot produce residuals

latency.description: time between the event and its closure (e.g. monthly, instantaneous)

scale.description: robust scale (MAD-based) measured on a declared quiet window

attribution_terms.description: subset of term names that a residual may be attributed to; anything else makes the event unattributed and non-actionable
